description: Get a rendered map image (PNG) of a flight by fa_flight_id. On a local install it writes the PNG to disk (default: $AEROAPI_OUTPUT_DIR, else ~/Downloads/flightaware-mcp) and returns the path, or returns the image inline when inline:true (up to 10 MiB; a bigger map is saved to disk, with a note). On a hosted server it returns the image inline when it fits, otherwise a signed, expiring download link (url, expiresAt) — never a path on the server's disk.

inline.description: Return the PNG inline as an image instead of writing to disk (capped at 10 MiB). Hosted: inline is already the default; inline:false returns a download link.

output_dir.description: Local install only: directory to write the PNG to (default: $AEROAPI_OUTPUT_DIR, else ~/Downloads/flightaware-mcp). Must be inside that default directory. On a hosted server a download link is returned instead.

show_data_block.description: Overlay the flight data block on the map

name: fa_get_flight_map
